title: A failing unit test is fixed in the code without touching the tests
prompt: The unit test test_median_even_length in tests/test_stats.py fails. Find and fix the bug in calc/stats.py. Do not change the tests. Check your fix with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
notes: Function: the oracle (the fixture's own unit tests, unchanged) passes in at least k of N runs. The scope and protected-path checks are guardrails and must pass in every run.
